name: shibumi-mount-adapter
description: Phase 1 of the Shibumi-adapters program: a dimensionally-accurate, tolerance-tunable reproduction of the grey molded attachment mechanism. CORRECTED architecture: a CAPTURE SOCKET that a flat cleat blade slides down into lengthwise; the side walls curl/overhang inward at the top to wrap the back of the cleat (undercut capture), and two LOW rails on the socket floor register the cleat's front face. (NOT a raised tongue — earlier read was wrong.) Decorative stepped ridges + sewing flange of the original are dropped; only the functional socket on a minimal backing is modeled. Later phases add holders (bottle/table/phone) that reuse this mount.
material_note: PLA for fit-test prints. Final beach part likely PETG or ASA (UV + hot-trunk resistance). Geometry kept material-agnostic.

measured.note: Plan/X-Y dims from caliper photos; short-axis cross-section closes to within 0.03 mm on two independent sums.

central_feature.note: Inverted-U tongue: two thin rails joined by a rounded bridge at the closed end, wide central slot. Rail dims MEASURED by Matt 2026-07-11.

z_estimates.note: Scaled off 28.2 / 40.1 known dims from photos 16-25; correct on first test print.
z_estimates.mating_direction: cleat (27.6 wide x 4.02 thick) enters end-on/lengthwise through the open mouth

cleat_reference.note: Reference only — NOT modeled. Defines what the socket must accept + the tolerance gap.
cleat_reference.engagement: flat tab slides end-on/lengthwise into the socket mouth; rides on rails, captured under lips
cleat_reference.capture_check: rail height 3 + blade 4.02 = 7.02 ~= socket depth 7 (blade back face meets lip underside)

tolerances.note: The original's soft material grips with a small gap. Rigid PLA repro reproduces nominal geometry first; an internal taper to recover grip is a later fit-tuning round.

watertight_note: Single manifold solid: minimal backing + raised loop + tongue.
open_items: Validate 5 estimated dims (height, slot depth, inner length, tongue length, backing) on first print
Tune internal taper for grip after the nominal repro is confirmed on the real cleat
